subject.title: [Feature]: Improve Workspace Skill Loading: Add Frontmatter Parsing Error Visibility and Validation for SKILL.md

question: Should malformed SKILL.md diagnostics be limited to a new skills lint command first, or must normal skills list, skills check, skills.status, and Web surfaces also report skipped candidates before this issue is considered solved?
rationale: The current code gap is source-reproducible, but issue #57091 asks for both validation and user-facing visibility while PR #92028 primarily adds a lint surface, so automation should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Require shared status diagnostics before closing
options.body: Treat skills lint as useful but keep this issue open until skipped candidates are threaded through the normal status/list/check/Web surfaces or a narrower follow-up is explicitly accepted.

options.title: Accept lint as the first milestone
options.body: Land a repaired #92028 as the initial supported diagnostic surface and close this issue only if maintainers decide normal status/Web visibility is a separate request.

options.title: Defer broader skill UX
options.body: Leave the issue open without a fix PR until the skill authoring and discovery workflow is redesigned more broadly.

recommendation.title: Require shared status diagnostics before closing
recommendation.body: Treat skills lint as useful but keep this issue open until skipped candidates are threaded through the normal status/list/check/Web surfaces or a narrower follow-up is explicitly accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: This scope choice spans parser behavior, CLI/docs UX, and maintainer-visible skill discovery policy, all areas where current history points to steipete as the best available decision owner.
